links.outcome: Sensitivity of two AI systems for dentinal caries on local historical radiographs against clinical outcomes
links.effect: Vendor A sensitivity 48.5% (95% CI 37.0-60.2), Vendor B 57.5% (95% CI 46.1-68.2), pooled 53.0% (95% CI 44.8-61.1); local validation feasible and revealed modest sensitivity.
links.quote: Vendor A achieved a sensitivity of 48.5% (95% CI: 37.0-60.2), Vendor B achieved 57.5% (95% CI: 46.1-68.2), and pooled sensitivity was 53.0% (95% CI: 44.8-61.1).

unlisted_practices: Outcomes-anchored longitudinal validation using clinical follow-up as ground truth rather than radiographic labels

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial dental AI systems via a proposed longitudinal outcomes-anchored validation practice to assess real-world diagnostic performance.
